segments.text: The current princess of Novus Aether and successor to the throne, Licia is a young, mischievous girl with little interest in the politics of her country, leaving the decision-making to the House of Nobles and its head, Gilbert. She is, however, very interested in what the “Prison” and the lower city are like (though she is terribly misinformed in this matter) and loves to do servant work such as hanging laundry and cooking.
From UTW Fansubs' review
王家の第一王女で継承順位は一位。
実父である現王が病に伏せっているため、代理として政務を執り行っている。
まだ戴冠の儀を行っていない彼女を｢無冠の女王｣と揶揄する貴族も居るが、
本人はまったく気にしていない様子。
明瞭で活力に溢れるが、育ちの良さ故か打たれ弱い一面も。
王家の人間にしては世俗への関心が強いようで、召使いから炊事や裁縫などの
仕事を奪っては迷惑がられている。
王家第一皇女，亦即皇位第一继承人。
因为现任王卧床不起，目前由她作为代理执掌政务。
虽然贵族中也有人讽刺还没继位的她为「无冠的女王」，但她本人并不以为意。
为人干脆直爽，向来活力充沛，但似乎是因为教养过严，也有着亦步亦趋的一面。
由于王家的人向来对庶民事项多加关心，要是被仆人抢了洗衣做饭等杂事，她就会一脸不悦。

A notorious serial killer in the Prison, always leaves behind a scene of gruesome bodies after kill. The victims' bodies were so torn up that some doubt whether or not it was even done by a human being.

The personal assassin of Gilbert, and one of the most dangerous people in the city.

cast.characterName: ユースティア・アストレア
cast.originalCharacterName: ユースティア・アストレア

segments.text: The title character, Eustia (everyone calls her Tia for short) was saved from having to work as a prostitute after Caim buys her. An orphan for as long as she could remember, Tia grew up under harsh conditions, having worked as a slave for a noble family before ending up in the “Prison”.
She is found to have the wing disease, although her wings are markedly different from the others; it is quickly revealed that Tia is a special winged case and may possess supernatural powers.

She is cheerful and optimistic, and she believes that there is a greater purpose to her life from the periodic dreams she sees. She is driven by a huge desire to help and bring happiness to others, especially Caim, whom she looks up to as the one who changed her bitter life up to that point for the better.
Edited from UTW Fansubs' review

Fate dealt Caim Astraea a cruel hand when the Grand Forte (Great Collapse) tore him from his family and thrust him into the unforgiving "Prison." There, his pretty-boy looks nearly condemned him to a life of servicing clients in a brothel. Fortune, however, had other plans.

The leader of the "Incorrosive Gold Chain" spotted Caim's potential, molding him into a lethal assassin. This twist of fate not only saved him from an unwanted profession but armed him with formidable skills. Caim's forte? A pair of non-reflective knives he wields with deadly grace, leaving most opponents out of their depth.

When the Chain's leader passed, Caim struck out on his own. Now he keeps the red-light district in line and takes odd jobs to pay the bills. Ironically, his aloof demeanor only fuels his popularity among the working girls he once nearly joined.

Life in the slammer, however, left its mark beyond his combat prowess. It buried his mother's mantra of "everyone's born with a purpose" under the weight of countless senseless deaths. These days, Caim scoffs at notions of fate and meaning, seeing them as sugarcoated pills for life's bitter realities.
Based on Wikipedia

cast.originalCharacterName: フィオネ・シルヴァリア

segments.text: The captain of the “Wing Hunters,” Fione has a steady sense of justice. She is a hard worker and devotes herself entirely to her duties. She clings on very strongly to her beliefs, which makes her come off as stubborn and inflexible, as such is disliked by most “Prison” residents, sentiments she also shares back at them.

Fione’s personality gradually changes when she and Caim join forces to rid the “Prison” of a serial killer known as “Black Wings.” They get to know one another as the investigation proceeds, and her condescending attitude towards the “Prison” residents disappears as she comes to understand their way of life.
From UTW Fansubs' review

cast.characterName: エリス・フローラリア
cast.originalCharacterName: エリス・フローラリア

segments.text: Eris is a gorgeous woman who serves as the only female doctor in a red-light district, garnering high respect from many. Her medical expertise is unquestionable, yet she modestly charges just enough to get by.

Seven years ago, when she was nearly sold into prostitution, Caim stepped in and took her under his wing. After completing her medical education four years later, Caim asked her to live a free life without him, but she refused. As a compromise, she now lives in a different house and visits Caim's house regularly to cook and do laundry. However, Eris is a lousy cook and not particularly good at housework. Nevertheless, she is good at concocting medicines.
Eris doesn't take kindly to any woman getting close to Caim, especially Tia, who filled her shoes in Caim's house and took over cooking duties, whom Eris refers to as 'little critter'.
Caim's act of buying Eris' freedom was driven by a guilty conscience, a way to square things with himself for the death of her parents.
Edited from Wikipedia

cast.originalCharacterName: コレット・アナスタシア

segments.text: The 29th saint who presides over the faith of the Saint Irene Church, the sole religious institution in Novus Aether. Commonly known as the "Blind Saint," she stands out for her exceptional popularity among all saints, residing in the grand cathedral's sanctuary in the Upper District. Irene ascended to her role after the previous saint was executed for taking responsibility for the "Great Collapse."

Despite becoming blind shortly after her inauguration due to severe fever, she strangely regains her sight within the sanctuary. Irene is filled with faith yet embodies youthful competitiveness and stubbornness, steadfastly adhering to her convictions. She frequently clashes with the high priest, leading to a notably strained relationship. Her attendant, Laviria, often bears the brunt of her harshness.

Despite her high learning ability, particularly in chess, where she ensures she does not repeat mistakes, Caim always seems to best her. Caim and Iris critique her for having talent but being overly simplistic in her approach.
Translated and edited from the official site and Wikipedia

segments.text: After the King was bedridden due to an illness, Gilbert became the regent for Princess Licia, who is too young to govern. Manipulative and cunning, Gilbert uses the impressionable Licia as his pawn to rule the kingdom, and Gau the "Mad Dog" to silence his enemies and anyone who seek out the secrets of the city.
